name: Ambivalence
summary: A Kaizo ROM hack of Super Mario World created by drkrdnk. Built primarily using vanilla game mechanics with custom music and ASM quality-of-life patches, the hack features 11 linear exits designed to be approachable for players transitioning into intermediate and advanced Kaizo platforming. It includes an introductory museum level to explain custom indicators and hazards, along with fast-paced, flow-focused obstacle courses.
